II. Power sharing is desirable because democracy requires government with the consent of the governed.

Both Statement I and II are Prudential
Statement I is Prudential; Statement II is Moral
Both Statement I and II are Moral
questions.explanation: Statement I focuses on practical beneficial outcomes (avoiding war = Prudential), while Statement II focuses on intrinsic democratic values (consent of the governed = Moral).

questions.subtopic: Core Axiom of Democratic Power Sharing
questions.question: What is the ultimate purpose of power sharing in a constitutional democracy?
options: To ensure that elections are never conducted again
To eliminate all opposition political parties
To ensure that power is not concentrated in any single hand and that all citizens have a meaningful voice in governance
To transfer all legislative authority to international corporations
questions.explanation: Power sharing is a basic principle of democracy because people are the source of political power and should have a voice in shaping public policy. It also helps prevent any one organ, level, group or party from monopolising power.
